links.outcome: Reproducibility of class assignments across repeated runs (Fleiss' kappa)
links.effect: Average kappa 0.86 (minimal input) and 0.91 (full input); DeepSeek lowest (0.62-0.79), Gemini best (0.98 full).
links.quote: The models exhibited consistently high agreement across prompts, with the average Fleiss’s kappa values of 0.86 under minimal and 0.91 under full-form input.
